description.mode: parasitic = served by same server that provides APIs; standalone = served by own gateway, APIs from apiBase
description.apiBase: OpenAI-compatible base URL for standalone mode (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1). Empty in parasitic mode.
description.apiKey: Bearer token for upstream API (standalone mode only).
description.model: Default model name. Empty uses the server-reported model from /health.
